title: Twins' matching nightmares in two states

tellings.quote: Jim and Jack both at the same time in two different states. Jim lived in Massachusetts Jack in Vermont with his wife. They both started experiencing these identical nightmares and

plain: Twin brothers named Jim Weiner and Jack Weiner are said to have started having the same nightmares at the same time in the late 1980s, while living in two different states: Jim in Massachusetts and Jack in Vermont with his wife. Charlie Foltz, himself a witness connected with the brothers, tells this to Michels in an episode about alien abduction. He offers the matching dreams as a sign that the brothers shared a hidden experience.
